description: Source code for an ATM driver core functions for Lantiq hardware, including device initialization, data handling, and hardware configuration.

methods.name: ppe_ioctl
methods.description: Handles IOCTL commands for retrieving or setting ATM device information.

methods.name: ppe_open
methods.description: Opens an ATM VCC, allocates resources, and configures hardware for data transmission.

methods.name: ppe_close
methods.description: Closes an ATM VCC, releases resources, and updates hardware state.

methods.name: ppe_send
methods.description: Sends an ATM cell or packet through the hardware, updating descriptors and signaling.

methods.name: ppe_send_oam
methods.description: Sends an OAM cell for management purposes.

methods.name: ppe_change_qos
methods.description: Updates QoS parameters for an ATM VCC.

methods.name: atm_showtime_enter
methods.description: Enters showtime mode, configuring hardware for active data transfer.

methods.name: atm_showtime_exit
methods.description: Exits showtime mode, restoring hardware to idle state.

methods.name: set_qsb
methods.description: Configures Quality of Service parameters in hardware queues.

methods.name: qsb_global_set
methods.description: Sets global QSB parameters based on port configurations.

methods.name: set_htu_entry
methods.description: Configures hardware lookup table entries for VPI/VCI mapping.

methods.name: clear_htu_entry
methods.description: Clears a hardware lookup table entry.

methods.name: validate_oam_htu_entry
methods.description: Enables OAM HTU entries.

methods.name: invalidate_oam_htu_entry
methods.description: Disables OAM HTU entries.

methods.name: find_vpi
methods.description: Finds connection index by VPI.

methods.name: find_vpivci
methods.description: Finds connection index by VPI and VCI.

methods.name: find_vcc
methods.description: Finds connection index by vcc pointer.

methods.name: ifx_atm_version
methods.description: Retrieves ATM firmware version information.

methods.name: check_parameters
methods.description: Validates and adjusts configuration parameters.

methods.name: init_priv_data
methods.description: Initializes private data structures and hardware descriptors.

methods.name: clear_priv_data
methods.description: Frees allocated resources and resets private data.

methods.name: init_rx_tables
methods.description: Initializes receive queue and descriptor tables.

methods.name: init_tx_tables
methods.description: Initializes transmit queue and descriptor tables.
